People: Prince Consort Albert (author, Wikidata Q152245), died 1861; Arthur Helps (editor, Wikidata Q321238), died 1875. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Albert, Prince Consort, consort of Victoria, Queen of Great Britain, 1819-1861; Helps, Arthur, Sir, 1813-1875 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The principal speeches and addresses of His Royal Highness the Prince Consort, London, J. Murray, 1862, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/principalspeech00helpgoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 83%, 93%, 94% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Arthur Helps, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
